idea-plugin.name: CKB - Invisible Reality Architecture Intelligence
idea-plugin.description:
CKB – Invisible Reality Architecture Intelligence

Explore software as an evidence-backed internal system instead of a flat collection of files.

  • 🌌 Living Architecture Reality cockpit inside the IDE
  • 🔬 Cursor-driven Semantic Editor Reality V10: LINE → CALL → SYMBOL → FILE → SUBSYSTEM → SYSTEM
  • ☁️ Cursor Reality continuity into Cloud X-Ray and contextual Raiziom investigation
  • 🧬 Molecular software microscope with semantic depth and truth-separated lenses
  • 🟢 Live Transmission Field V8 for exact observed HTTP, DB, cache, queue, event, WebSocket and function transitions
  • ↯ Exact parent/child runtime retracing when telemetry provides safe trace semantics
  • ⚡ Deep activity hotspots, change sensitivity and architecture boundaries
  • 🧠 Bounded architecture memory for AI/model context without dumping the whole repository
  • 🛡️ Evidence-backed architecture findings and dependency drift
  • 🔮 Change ripple analysis before code is modified
  • 🤖 MCP/agent integration for model-neutral architecture intelligence
Runtime animation and source-level runtime context are produced only from observed telemetry; static relationships are never presented as execution.

Supports IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, GoLand, Rider and Android Studio families where platform compatibility permits.
